items.title: The Timberwolves will have their usual season opening theater as part of the introductions. Every player will be announced, except for Donte DiVincenzo. The team and Donte agreed that they want his first announcement to be when he returns to the court to play.
items.author: Jon Krawczynski

items.title: It's good to see Ariel Hukporti is getting his Achilles surgery today. This is the second guy (Donte DiVincenzo) to rupture an Achilles after Tatum & both are following his lead in getting surgery done the next day. This is the new standard.
